Bug_Title: Nm: Method doesn’t override method in superclass due to wrong package for parameter (NM_WRONG_PACKAGE)
Bug_Explanation: The method 'f(Foo x)' defined in class B doesn't override the 'f(Foo x)' method defined in class A, because the argument types are Foo's from different packages. Since both Foo classes are in the default package now, the methods are considered as overriding each other, causing the bug to show up.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case triggers the bug because the 'Foo' class used in the test belongs to the default package, while the 'f(Foo x)' method in class A expects a 'Foo' class from a different package (either alpha or beta, depending on how the code is refactored).
